cadenas.Acometida eléctrica desde el punto de su: Electrical service from the supply point.
cadenas.Acometida eléctrica provisional de obra: Temporary electrical supply for the works, with a distribution panel.
Temporary electrical supply for the works with a distribution panel. Includes running the cable and the panel. Measured per supply actually installed.
Temporary electrical supply for the works.
cadenas.Acometida provisional de agua de obra. I: Temporary water supply for the works. Includes connecting to the main and the main stop valve. Measured per supply actually installed.
cadenas.Aislamiento de servicio de gas existente: Isolation of the existing gas service.
cadenas.Aislamiento del servicio de gas existent: Isolation of the existing gas service, by shutting off and temporarily capping the line. Includes closing the gas valve and capping it securely. Measured per service isolated.
cadenas.Alquiler de baño portátil de obra, por m: Rental of a portable site toilet, per month. Includes supply and cleaning. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Apeo de cubierta o techo durante trabajo: Shoring of a roof during strengthening work. Includes placing the shores. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a lintel while an opening is formed.
cadenas.Apeo de dintel durante la apertura de va: Shoring of a lintel while the opening is formed. Includes placing the shores. Measured per linear meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de escalera existente durante traba: Shoring of an existing stair during strengthening work. Includes placing the shores. Measured per linear meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de fachada durante demolición parci: Shoring of a facade during partial demolition.
Shoring of a facade during partial demolition. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de losa con puntales metálicos y du: Shoring of a slab with steel shores and spreader beams. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with shores and spreader beams.
cadenas.Apeo de losa con torres de carga metálic: Shoring of a slab with steel load towers. Includes erecting the towers. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with steel load towers. Includes erecting the towers. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with load towers.
cadenas.Apeo de viga con puntales metálicos. Inc: Shoring of a beam with steel shores. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per linear meter shored.
Shoring of a beam with shores.
cadenas.Apeo o arriostramiento provisional de mu: Temporary shoring or bracing of a wall using raking shores with spreader beams, to stabilize it against thrust or overturning while work goes on around it. Must follow the instruction of the engineer or architect in charge. Includes setting out the bearing points, preparing the spreader bases on the floor, erecting and loading the raking shores, periodically checking stability and tightness, and dismantling once the element has been made good. Measured over the area of wall actually shored.
Temporary shoring or bracing of a wall.
cadenas.Apertura de cata de reconocimiento en pa: Exploratory opening in a wall, roughly 30x30 cm, to identify the type of substrate, its thickness or the presence of concealed services before the work is designed. Includes scanning beforehand with an electronic detector so as not to drill into a live pipe or cable, carefully breaking out layer by layer until the element being sought is exposed, photographic recording of what is found, and patching the opening with repair mortar so the face is left ready for its finish. Measured per opening actually carried out.
cadenas.Apertura de cata de reconocimiento en pi: Exploratory opening in a floor or slab, roughly 40x40 cm, to identify the thickness and condition of the sub-base, whether waterproofing is present, or whether services are buried below, before the work is defined. Includes scanning beforehand with a detector, cutting around the perimeter with a disc saw for a clean edge, breaking out layer by layer and recording the thickness of each, photographic recording, and reinstating the opening with repair mortar finished flush with the existing level. Measured per opening actually carried out.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de muro con madera y punt: Shoring of a wall with timber and shores. Includes installing the shoring. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a wall with timber.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de talud o excavación int: Shoring of an internal slope or excavation. Includes installing the trench sheeting. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de vano durante la apertu: Shoring of an opening while it is formed.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento provisional del muro situ: Temporary shoring of the wall over an opening that is to be formed or widened, using shores and spreader beams that carry the load of the masonry above while the demolition is carried out and the permanent lintel is placed. This is what stops the masonry collapsing when its support is removed. Includes setting out, cutting the bearing pockets for the spreader beam into the wall, erecting and loading the shores on both faces, checking them during the demolition, removing the shoring once the permanent lintel has cured and taken load, and patching the bearing pockets. Measured per opening actually shored.
cadenas.Bajante con contador de descargas y mand: Down conductor with strike counter and test joint.
Bare copper down conductor with fixings.
cadenas.Barrera antipolvo con lámina plástica y: Dust barrier in plastic sheeting with an access opening.
cadenas.Barrera provisional de confinamiento de: Temporary dust containment barrier between the work area and the areas still in use, made up of a timber batten frame with polyethylene sheeting stretched and sealed around its whole perimeter against floor, walls and ceiling, with a zip door for access. This is what allows work to go on in one room while the rest of the building stays occupied and operating. Includes setting out, erecting the frame, fitting and sealing the sheeting, fitting the access opening, maintaining the barrier while the works last, and dismantling and removing it at the end. Measured over the area of barrier actually erected.
cadenas.Baño portátil de obra, por mes de perman: Portable site toilet, per month on site.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica empotrada con con: Concealed electrical conduit, 20 mm, with 12 AWG conductor.

Air terminal on a chimney for lightning protection.

Store or enclosed area for materials, per month. Includes erection and the period on site. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Cata en muro para reconocimiento de espe: Exploratory opening in a wall to check its thickness and makeup. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per linear meter of opening.
Exploratory opening in a wall to check its thickness.
cadenas.Cata en pared para reconocimiento de ins: Exploratory opening in a wall to identify services or substrate.
cadenas.Cata en piso o losa para reconocimiento: Exploratory opening in a floor or slab to identify layers or services.
cadenas.Cata en techo o cara inferior de losa pa: Exploratory opening in a ceiling or the underside of a slab to inspect the structure. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per linear meter of opening.
cadenas.Cata en techo para reconocimiento de los: Exploratory opening in a ceiling to inspect the slab.
cadenas.Cata para localización de tubería enterr: Exploratory opening to locate a buried pipe.
Exploratory opening to locate a buried pipe. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per opening carried out.
cadenas.Central domótica con configuración inici: Home automation controller with initial configuration.
Home automation controller with remote control.
cadenas.Cerramiento perimetral provisional de ob: Temporary perimeter hoarding with warning mesh.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional de vano con lámi: Temporary closure of an opening with a wood panel.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional de vano de puert: Temporary closure of a door or window opening using a plywood or OSB panel on a batten frame, anchored into the opening. Used to close up voids left by demolition or by removing doors and windows, keeping the interior safe from the weather and from intruders until the permanent units arrive. Includes setting out and cutting the panel, building the frame, fixing it into the opening with anchors, sealing around the perimeter, maintaining it while the works last, and taking it down when the permanent units are fitted. Measured over the area of opening actually closed.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional del perímetro de: Temporary enclosure of the perimeter of the work area using plastic warning mesh on steel or timber posts, with warning signs. It defines the work area and keeps unauthorized people out, a basic safety requirement where the works share the site with areas still in use or open onto common areas. Includes setting out, placing and bracing the posts, stretching and fixing the mesh, putting up the warning signs, maintaining it while the works last, and dismantling and removing it at the end. Measured over the length actually enclosed.
cadenas.Cierre y bloqueo de suministro eléctrico: Shut-off and lock-out of the electrical supply.
cadenas.Cierre y bloqueo del suministro eléctric: Shut-off and lock-out of the main electrical supply to the work area. Includes switching off the main isolator and locking it out. Measured per service locked out.
Shut-off and draining of the water installation.
cadenas.Cierre y drenaje de la instalación de ag: Shut-off and draining of the water installation serving the work area. Includes closing the stop valves and draining the pipework. Measured per service shut off.
cadenas.Conductor captador de cumbrera y perímet: Air-termination conductor along the ridge and roof perimeter.
cadenas.Control de planitud de pisos con regla y: Flatness check of floors with a straightedge and level. Includes the check. Measured per square meter checked.
Geometric check of wall and ceiling surfaces.
cadenas.Control geométrico de plomos y niveles d: Geometric check that wall and ceiling surfaces are plumb and level. Includes checking with a laser level. Measured per square meter checked.
cadenas.Desconexión de equipo de aire acondicion: Disconnection of air conditioning equipment, with recovery of the refrigerant. Includes refrigerant recovery and electrical disconnection. Measured per unit disconnected.
cadenas.Desconexión de instalación eléctrica exi: Disconnection of the existing electrical installation.
cadenas.Desconexión de la instalación de agua ex: Disconnection of the existing water installation before work starts, by shutting off the stop valves. Includes shutting off and checking that the system is watertight. Measured per installation disconnected.
cadenas.Desconexión de la instalación de gas exi: Disconnection of the existing gas installation before work starts, by shutting off the gas valve. Includes shutting off and checking for leaks. Measured per installation disconnected.
cadenas.Desconexión de la instalación eléctrica: Disconnection of the existing electrical installation before work starts, by cutting the supply and making it safe. Includes verifying that the circuit is dead and locking it out. Measured per installation disconnected.
cadenas.Detección de armadura y recubrimiento en: Detection of reinforcement and concrete cover in a concrete element. Includes measurement with a detector. Measured per element inspected.
cadenas.Diagnóstico de humedades en paramento, c: Diagnosis of damp in a wall surface, with moisture measurement. Includes inspection and recording. Measured per point diagnosed.
Diagnosis of damp in a wall surface.
cadenas.Ejecución de red provisional de desagüe: Installation of temporary site drainage. Includes the connection and the pipe run. Measured per system installed.
cadenas.Ensayo de carga o prueba de estructura e: Load test or proof test of the existing structure.
cadenas.Estabilización de muro con arriostramien: Stabilizing a wall with temporary steel bracing. Includes installing the bracing. Measured per square meter stabilized.
cadenas.Habilitación de una zona cerrada dentro: Fitting out an enclosed area within the site for storing materials and keeping tools, either by building an enclosure in sheet wood on a frame with a door and lock, or by adapting an existing room. Includes building the enclosure and fitting the door with a lock, protecting the floor of the storage area, providing shelving or pallets to keep materials off the ground, keeping it tidy throughout the period, and dismantling it when the works finish. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Habilitación de zona de lavado de herram: Fitting out an area for washing tools. Includes the water connection and marking out the area. Measured per area fitted out.
cadenas.Iluminación provisional de los frentes d: Temporary lighting of the work faces using site floodlights on stands or suspended, fed from the temporary panel, providing the light level needed to work safely and to a good finish. Includes distributing the lighting points among the active work faces, running the cable, fixing the floodlights clear of walkways and of the line of throw of materials, repositioning them as the works progress, replacing lamps, and dismantling at the end. Measured over the area of the works actually lit.
cadenas.Iluminación provisional de obra, con ref: Temporary site lighting with floodlights. Includes installing the floodlights. Measured per point installed.
Detector installation in a living room.
Air conditioning unit installation for a consulting room.
Air conditioning unit installation for a study.
Air conditioning unit installation for a bedroom.

Fire extinguisher installation in a storeroom.
Fire extinguisher installation in a garage.
Fire extinguisher installation in commercial premises.

Fire extinguisher installation on a terrace.
cadenas.Instalación de inodoro con su conexión d: Toilet installation, including water and drain connections.
cadenas.Instalación de lavamanos con su grifería: Lavatory installation, including faucet and drain.
cadenas.Instalación de luminaria de emergencia c: Emergency light fixture installation with sign.
cadenas.Instalación de luminaria de sobreponer o: Surface-mounted or pendant light fixture installation.
cadenas.Instalación de luminaria empotrada en ci: Recessed light fixture installation in a suspended ceiling.
Manual fire alarm pull station installation.
cadenas.Instalación de punto de agua provisional: Installation of a temporary water point for mixing mortar, cleaning and general use on site, made up of a branch off the existing main with a stop valve, a reinforced hose run to the work face, and a discharge point with collection. Includes checking the available pressure, fitting the valve and accessories, running the hose along routes protected from traffic, providing for the run-off so finished areas are not flooded, maintaining it while the works last, and dismantling it at the end and reinstating the draw-off point. Measured per point actually installed.
cadenas.Instalación de reflector o luminaria de: Outdoor floodlight or light fixture installation.
LED strip installation in the baseboard.
cadenas.Instalación de ventilador de baño con se: Bathroom fan installation with a sensor.
Video intercom or door entry intercom installation.
cadenas.Instalación eléctrica provisional para e: Temporary electrical installation to supply the works, made up of a distribution panel with a ground-fault circuit interrupter and circuit breakers, power outlets, and heavy-duty rubber cable run to the work faces. Includes connecting to the authorized supply point, mounting and fixing the panel somewhere protected and accessible, running the cable along routes that cross neither walkways nor wet areas, grounding the whole installation, testing that the ground-fault interrupter trips before the system is brought into service, maintaining it while the works last, and dismantling it at the end. Measured per installation actually carried out.
cadenas.Interruptor diferencial de protección de: Ground-fault circuit interrupter for personal protection.
cadenas.Interruptor termomagnético de protección: Circuit breaker for branch circuit protection.
cadenas.Levantamiento de instalaciones existente: Survey of existing services (electrical, plumbing). Includes inspection and recording. Measured per square meter surveyed.
cadenas.Levantamiento de medidas del inmueble ex: Measured survey of the existing building.
cadenas.Levantamiento de patologías de paramento: Survey of defects in wall and ceiling surfaces (damp, cracking, delamination). Includes inspection and recording. Measured per square meter inspected.
Condition survey of defects in wall and ceiling surfaces.
cadenas.Levantamiento en sitio de las medidas de: Measured survey on site of the existing building, taking the dimensions of rooms, clear heights, openings and the position of visible services and structural elements, in order to produce the as-built drawing on which the refurbishment is designed. Includes measuring with a laser distance meter and tape, checking squareness and plumb, a dimensioned sketch drawn on site, photographic recording of every room and noting any visible defects. Measured over the floor area of the building actually surveyed.
cadenas.Levantamiento topográfico interior de la: Interior topographic survey of the works. Includes measurement and recording of levels. Measured per square meter surveyed.
cadenas.Localización de tuberías, canalizaciones: Locating buried pipes, electrical conduit and embedded reinforcement with an electronic detector, without breaking out the face, and marking the runs on the surface. This is the prior step that prevents cutting into a live service when cutting chases or drilling, and lets the new services be laid out around the existing ones. Includes systematically scanning the surface, marking the runs detected, noting the estimated depths and drawing up a sketch of what was found. Measured over the area actually scanned.
cadenas.Malla captadora de cubierta para protecc: Roof air-termination network for lightning protection.
cadenas.Mantenimiento y limpieza de equipo de cl: Maintenance and cleaning of HVAC equipment.
cadenas.Módulo de actuación on/off para circuito: On/off actuator module for lighting circuits.
cadenas.Módulo de control de persiana o cortina: Control module for a motorized blind or curtain.
cadenas.Módulo de enchufe inteligente para carga: Smart plug module for plug-in loads.
cadenas.Panel táctil de pared para el sistema do: Wall-mounted touch panel for the home automation system.
cadenas.Pararrayos con dispositivo de cebado sob: Early streamer emission air terminal on a mast on the roof.
cadenas.Pararrayos tipo Franklin de punta simple: Franklin lightning rod, single point, on a support.
cadenas.Protección de carpintería y aparatos que: Protection of doors, windows and fixtures remaining on site.
cadenas.Protección de mobiliario y equipos con l: Protection of furniture and equipment with plastic sheeting.
cadenas.Protección de mobiliario, electrodomésti: Protection of furniture, appliances and equipment that stay in the building during the works, using polyethylene sheeting held with tape. Includes first moving the furniture together in the area furthest from the work face, covering it completely with lapped sheeting, sealing with tape to keep dust out, checking the protection periodically while the works last, and removing and disposing of it at the end. Measured over the area of furniture actually protected.
cadenas.Protección de piso existente que permane: Protection of existing flooring that is to remain, using overlapping rolls of corrugated cardboard taped at the joints, laid over polyethylene sheeting where there is a risk of moisture. Used on partial refurbishments where the flooring in areas not being worked on has to be handed back undamaged. Includes cleaning the surface beforehand, laying and lapping the material, sealing the joints and the perimeter against the baseboard, replacing any areas that deteriorate during the works, and removing and disposing of the protection when the work finishes. Measured over the area actually protected.
cadenas.Protección de piso terminado durante la: Protection of finished flooring while the works are carried out.
cadenas.Protección de puertas, ventanas, aparato: Protection of doors, windows, plumbing fixtures and finished elements that remain inside the work area, using plastic sheeting and cardboard held with low-tack tape that leaves no residue and does not damage the finishes. Includes masking frames, hardware and glazing, covering the plumbing fixtures still in service, replacing protection that becomes damaged, and removing it and cleaning up when the works finish. Measured over the area actually protected.
cadenas.Protector contra sobretensiones para lín: Surge protective device for data and telecommunications lines.
cadenas.Protector contra sobretensiones tipo 3 p: Type 3 surge protective device for sensitive equipment.
cadenas.Protector contra sobretensiones transito: Type 1 surge protective device at the main panel.
Type 2 surge protective device at the subpanel.
cadenas.Prueba de estanqueidad de instalación de: Watertightness test of the existing water installation. Includes pressurizing and checking. Measured per test carried out.
Watertightness test of the water installation.
cadenas.Prueba y verificación del sistema de pro: Testing and verification of the lightning protection system.
cadenas.Prueba y verificación del sistema domóti: Testing and verification of the home automation system.
cadenas.Puesta a disposición de baño portátil pa: Provision of a portable toilet for the site workforce, including delivery, siting, maintenance and periodic emptying for one month. Required on sites with no usable sanitary facilities, and it keeps the workforce out of the facilities of a building being refurbished. Includes transport and siting at a point the service truck can reach, supplying consumables, periodic emptying and cleaning, and removal at the end of the period. Measured per month on site.

cadenas.Punto de agua provisional de obra, con l: Temporary water point for the works, with a valve and hose. Includes the connection and the valve. Measured per point installed.
Temporary water point for the works.

Data outlet in the suspended ceiling.

cadenas.Punto de fuerza para electrodoméstico o: Power outlet for an appliance or piece of equipment.

Gas connection for a water heater.

Gas connection for a range or water heater.
Gas connection for the laundry room.
Gas connection for a barbecue grill.
Gas connection for a clothes dryer.

cadenas.Realización de ensayo o prueba de carga: Carrying out a load test or proof test of the existing structure. Includes preparation and measurement. Measured per test carried out.

cadenas.Replanteo de desagües y pendientes de pi: Setting out of floor drains and falls. Includes marking the falls. Measured per linear meter set out.
Setting out of drains and falls.
cadenas.Replanteo de ejes de muros con nivel lás: Setting out of wall grid lines with a laser level. Includes marking the lines. Measured per linear meter set out.
Setting out of wall grid lines.
cadenas.Replanteo de escalera y peldaños. Incluy: Setting out of a stair and its treads. Includes marking the treads and risers. Measured per stair set out.
cadenas.Replanteo de instalaciones (eléctrica, s: Setting out of services (electrical, plumbing) with the runs marked. Includes marking. Measured per installation set out.
cadenas.Replanteo de niveles y pendientes de pis: Setting out of floor levels and falls. Includes marking the levels. Measured per linear meter set out.
Setting out of levels and falls.
cadenas.Replanteo de particiones y tabiques. Inc: Setting out of partitions and partition walls. Includes marking the grid lines. Measured per square meter set out.
Setting out of openings and door and window units.
cadenas.Replanteo de vanos y carpintería. Incluy: Setting out of openings and door and window units. Includes marking the positions. Measured per linear meter set out.
cadenas.Replanteo general de la intervención sob: General setting out of the works in the building, marking the partition grid lines, the finished floor levels and the datum levels, carried out with a laser level and measuring equipment. Includes checking squareness and comparing the actual geometry against the drawing, marking the grid lines on floor and walls, establishing the datum level that will govern the whole job, marking the fixed reference points and noting any discrepancies found against the design. Measured over the area of work actually set out.
cadenas.Replanteo general de la obra y trazado d: General setting out of the works and marking of grid lines.
cadenas.Reubicación de punto eléctrico existente: Relocation of an existing electrical point.
cadenas.Revisión y certificación de instalación: Inspection and certification of the electrical installation.

cadenas.Suministro y colocación de botiquín de p: Supply and siting of a site first aid kit. Includes the contents and restocking them. Measured per kit supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de extintor de o: Supply and siting of a site fire extinguisher. Includes fixing it in place and signing it. Measured per extinguisher supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de extintor port: Supply and installation of a portable fire extinguisher.
cadenas.Sustitución de tramo de tubería de agua: Replacement of a section of existing water pipe.
cadenas.Tubería de agua de PPR de 20 mm, empotra: 20 mm PPR water pipe, concealed, including chasing and patching.
cadenas.Tubería frigorífica y drenaje para clima: Refrigerant piping and drain for the HVAC system.
cadenas.Unión equipotencial de la bajante con la: Equipotential bonding of the down conductor to the general grounding system.
